summary: xAI announced that eToro's AI agent Tori now uses xAI's models to provide real-time market sentiment analysis drawn from X.

mechanisms.reason: xAI models are being deployed into a consumer investing platform with a large registered user base, adding a new inference-serving surface.
mechanisms.quote: eToro users to ask and analyze market sentiment using Tori ... eToro has built a place where people invest together, and today has more than 40 million registered users across 75 countries.
